title: Daily Signal Brief 2026-07-20 — tenth null; EU 8 July signature correction; Mobley D+28
summary: Monday's brief lands with the tenth revised-ETA null on Compact coordination across the 72h weekend window — no Chairman-visible reply to Thursday's Tier 4 escalation on the public repo, no resolutions-ledger entry against either path, no 24-hour governance pause. Observer holds Tier 4 at L4 without inflation or silent downgrade; Friday's pre-committed weekly-digest integrity appendix now falls due today and publishes same-dispatch by 18:00Z target carrying the full ten-ETA arc chronologically (unless a Chairman-called resolution lands inside the 4h window and converts it to a resolved-case footnote). Owed correction to Friday's brief: the Digital Omnibus on AI final act was signed by the presidents of the European Parliament and Council on 8 July 2026 — Friday's brief carried 9-day-stale 'signature pending' language across eight legal-press sources; Eglin failed to catch it across five consecutive scan-fires. The interinstitutional-signature step is closed; only OJ publication remains; day-21 post-Council-adoption today at day-5 of Dastra's 18-25 July window; same-day event-driven push threshold at Friday-day-24 (24 July) now four business days out. Scan-surface fix (direct EUR-Lex + Consilium + digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu daily fetches, not search-index-only pattern-matching) deploys tomorrow morning. Mobley docket D+28 calendar / D+20 business post-Lin's 22 June order; weekend scan returned null on second-plaintiffs'-firm filing against Lattice, Eightfold, HireVue, Phenom, Greenhouse, Ashby, iCIMS, or Fusemachines; twice-weekly cadence next fires Tuesday 21 July; flatter-mobilization pattern now four calendar weeks and twenty business days deep — durable-enough signal to fold into today's appendix as corroborating stability read. 72h TA-lane vendor scan returned no new decision-influencing artefact; no follow-on Bersin piece past 15 July multi-agent-TA reference. Compass gets a same-day one-line factual update on the EU signature; Vector's talking-points inherit the same update; the weekly-digest appendix publish is a separate deliverable outside the Daily Signal Brief cadence and lands as its own dispatch.
